messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

You can now enter a **Deal name** under “Reproduce a game.” Named snapshots restore that name when loaded; unnamed saves remain compatible with version 1. Names clear when you start, restart, or load a different board.

Snapshot loading now accepts valid JSON fields in any order, fixing the pasted saves that failed when `version` was not first.

Type checking and all 142 unit tests passed. The full browser run completed with one artwork timeout and one incorrect expectation in the new test; both checks passed on rerun after the expectation was corrected. The repository-wide formatting check also reported existing issues in 23 untouched files; all changed files pass formatting.
